Apple___Apple_scab.label: Apple Scab
Apple___Apple_scab.guidance: Remove and destroy fallen leaves. Apply fungicides proactively during the primary infection period in spring.

Apple___Black_rot.label: Apple Black Rot
Apple___Black_rot.guidance: Prune out dead or diseased branches. Remove mummified fruit and treat with appropriate fungicides.

Apple___healthy.label: Apple — Healthy
Apple___healthy.guidance: No disease detected. Continue regular monitoring and maintain good sanitation practices.

Corn___Common_rust.label: Corn Common Rust
Corn___Common_rust.guidance: Plant rust-resistant hybrids. Apply foliar fungicides if infection is severe early in the season.

Corn___Gray_leaf_spot.label: Corn Gray Leaf Spot
Corn___Gray_leaf_spot.guidance: Use crop rotation and tillage to reduce surface residue. Consider resistant hybrids and timely fungicide application.

Corn___healthy.label: Corn — Healthy
Corn___healthy.guidance: No disease detected. Continue regular monitoring.

Grape___Black_rot.label: Grape Black Rot
Grape___Black_rot.guidance: Remove all mummified fruit and infected tendrils. Maintain an open canopy and apply preventative fungicides.

Grape___healthy.label: Grape — Healthy
Grape___healthy.guidance: No disease detected. Continue routine care.

Pepper___bell___Bacterial_spot.label: Pepper Bacterial Spot
Pepper___bell___Bacterial_spot.guidance: Avoid overhead watering. Apply copper-based bactericides early and use disease-free seeds or transplants.

Pepper___bell___healthy.label: Pepper — Healthy
Pepper___bell___healthy.guidance: No disease detected. Maintain optimal watering.

Potato___Early_blight.label: Potato Early Blight
Potato___Early_blight.guidance: Ensure adequate nitrogen fertility. Apply protective fungicides and practice crop rotation.

Potato___Late_blight.label: Potato Late Blight
Potato___Late_blight.guidance: Destroy cull piles and volunteer potatoes. Apply systemic fungicides immediately; this spreads rapidly.

Potato___healthy.label: Potato — Healthy
Potato___healthy.guidance: No disease detected. Continue regular monitoring.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.label: Tomato Bacterial Spot
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.guidance: Avoid overhead irrigation and working with wet plants. Apply copper fungicides and use certified disease-free seed.

Tomato___Early_blight.label: Tomato Early Blight
Tomato___Early_blight.guidance: Remove affected leaves immediately. Avoid overhead watering. Apply copper-based fungicide if spread continues.

Tomato___Late_blight.label: Tomato Late Blight
Tomato___Late_blight.guidance: Remove infected plants immediately to prevent rapid spread. Apply appropriate fungicides.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.label: Tomato Leaf Mold
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.guidance: Increase air circulation and reduce humidity in greenhouses. Apply preventative fungicides.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.label: Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.guidance: Remove lower infected leaves, avoid overhead watering, and apply copper-based or chlorothalonil fungicide.

Tomato___Target_Spot.label: Tomato Target Spot
Tomato___Target_Spot.guidance: Improve airflow, remove crop debris, and spray protective fungicides.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.label: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.guidance: Control whitefly vectors using yellow sticky traps or insecticidal soaps. Remove and dispose of infected plants.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.label: Tomato Mosaic Virus
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.guidance: Disinfect tools, wash hands before handling plants, and remove infected plants to prevent transmission.

Tomato___healthy.label: Tomato — Healthy
Tomato___healthy.guidance: No disease detected. Continue standard preventative care.
